# Edit prompts and guides `EPG`

[As built](../README.md) › Edit prompts and guides

As built at `4b8570d19ee1`, read 2026-10-07.

Lets a user edit the markdown that defines agent prompts and project guides in a sheet editor, with outline navigation and save-on-close, via export:mountMarkdownEditor.
